key_drivers.name: Moscow oil refinery damaged in unprecedented drone assault
key_drivers.observed: Reuters reported several drones reached the Moscow oil refinery and damaged a facility during an unprecedented attack; Russia said more than 1,600 drones had been downed since Saturday, including 450 headed for Moscow. AP independently reported refinery damage. The extent of refinery damage and operating-rate impact was not yet established.
key_drivers.interpretation: Material Russia-Ukraine energy-infrastructure escalation that raises refined-product, European energy and war-risk pressure. No outage volume or duration is assumed until verified.

key_drivers.name: Hormuz oil/LNG flows remain materially improved versus the prior disruption
key_drivers.observed: CENTCOM commander Admiral Brad Cooper said oil and LNG shipments through Hormuz over the prior two weeks reached the highest level in six months and primary transit lanes are clear of mines.
key_drivers.interpretation: Material partial de-escalation in the chokepoint, reducing immediate complete-interruption tail-risk without establishing peacetime normalization.

key_drivers.name: U.S.-China AI/trade/critical-minerals talks launched
key_drivers.observed: Reuters reported Bessent and He Lifeng were set to launch New York talks covering AI, trade and critical minerals, including the approaching expiration of the trade truce and U.S. concerns about Chinese rare-earth exports.
key_drivers.interpretation: Potentially material for semiconductor/export-control, tariff and critical-mineral supply chains, but no negotiated policy outcome is assumed at this cutoff.
